crossRefs.note: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

translations.web: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
translations.bsb: At once the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness,
translations.kjv: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
translations.asv: And straightway the Spirit driveth him forth into the wilderness.
